about: The calibration set of spec §8 (R-18, S-06), written and committed before any score was seen. It has answerable and near-miss out-of-scope questions in each interface language; each pt-BR question translates the en question with the same number. An answerable question names the pinned passage that answers it (file and heading) and a phrase copied from it. A near-miss is an AI or web topic the docs do not cover, named by terms no corpus file contains. It never overlaps measurements/questions.json (R-20).

questions.question: How do I log errors that happen while streaming text?
questions.heading: Generating Text › `streamText` › `onError` callback
questions.evidence: To log errors, you can provide an `onError` callback that is triggered when an error occurs.

questions.question: How can I make the model pick one label from a fixed list?
questions.heading: Generating Structured Data › Output Types
questions.evidence: when you expect the model to choose from a specific set of string options

questions.question: How do I force the model to call one specific tool?
questions.heading: Tool Calling › Tool Choice
questions.evidence: the model must call the specified tool

questions.question: Which transport should I use to connect to an MCP server in production?
questions.heading: Model Context Protocol (MCP) › Initializing an MCP Client
questions.evidence: We recommend using HTTP transport (like `StreamableHTTPClientTransport`) for production deployments.

questions.question: How do I give a tool an API key without putting it in the prompt?
questions.heading: Runtime and Tool Context › Choosing the Right Context
questions.evidence: Use `toolsContext` and `contextSchema` for values needed by a specific tool, such as API keys

questions.question: Which Node.js version does code mode need?
questions.heading: Code Mode
questions.evidence: It requires Node.js 22 or newer and is not available in browser or edge runtimes.

questions.question: What temperature should I use for tool calls?
questions.heading: Prompt Engineering › Tips
questions.evidence: For tool calls and object generation, it's recommended to use `temperature: 0`

questions.question: How many times does the AI SDK retry a failed call by default?
questions.heading: Settings › Request Options
questions.evidence: Maximum number of retries. Set to 0 to disable retries. Default: `2`.

questions.question: What happens if I set reasoning on a provider that doesn't support it?
questions.heading: Reasoning › Provider Support
questions.evidence: emit an `unsupported` warning and ignore the parameter

questions.question: How do I generate several images from one prompt?
questions.heading: Image Generation › Settings
questions.evidence: `generateImage` also supports generating multiple images at once

questions.question: How do I transcribe live audio while it is still being recorded?
questions.heading: Transcription › Streaming Transcription
questions.evidence: Use `experimental_streamTranscribe` when you have live raw audio and need transcript updates before the full audio stream is complete.

questions.question: How do I get notified when a generated video is ready?
questions.heading: Video Generation › Settings › Webhooks
questions.evidence: For models with native webhook support, pass a `webhook` factory that returns a public URL

questions.question: How do I apply default settings to every call of a language model?
questions.heading: Language Model Middleware › Built-in Middleware
questions.evidence: The `defaultSettingsMiddleware` function can be used to apply default settings to a language model.

questions.question: How do I turn off telemetry for a single call?
questions.heading: Telemetry › Enabling telemetry
questions.evidence: To disable telemetry for a specific call, set `isEnabled: false`

questions.question: Is it safe to run AI SDK DevTools in production?
questions.heading: DevTools
questions.evidence: AI SDK DevTools is intended for local development only.
